perk.rpperks.survivor.name: §aSurvivor
perk.rpperks.survivor.desc: +2.5 hearts of max health, wounds heal faster (RP).
perk.rpperks.athlete.name: §aAthlete
perk.rpperks.athlete.desc: Physique 9–10: faster, higher step. With skill growth on, follows Physique.
perk.rpperks.tough.name: §aTough
perk.rpperks.tough.desc: +1.5 armor icons, +1.5 armor toughness, knockback resistance.
perk.rpperks.strongman.name: §aStrongman
perk.rpperks.strongman.desc: Strength 7+. With skill growth on, follows Strength.
perk.rpperks.tourist.name: §aTourist
perk.rpperks.tourist.desc: Better tolerance to ambient temperature and a strong immune system (RP).
perk.rpperks.organized.name: §aOrganized
perk.rpperks.lucky.name: §aLucky
perk.rpperks.lucky.desc: Higher luck: better loot and fishing.
perk.rpperks.enduring.name: §aEnduring
perk.rpperks.enduring.desc: Physique 7–8: more stamina. With skill growth on, follows Physique.
perk.rpperks.brave.name: §aBrave
perk.rpperks.strong_willed.name: §aStrong-willed
perk.rpperks.nerd_rage.name: §aNerd Rage
perk.rpperks.nerd_rage.desc: Below 20% health gains Strength II and Resistance II.
perk.rpperks.agile.name: §aAgile
perk.rpperks.solar_powered.name: §aSolar Powered
perk.rpperks.solar_powered.desc: In daylight under open sky gains Speed and faster stamina recovery.
perk.rpperks.light_travel.name: §aLight Traveler
perk.rpperks.light_travel.desc: +10% speed while wearing no more than 6 armor points.
perk.rpperks.alcoholic.name: §aHardened Drinker
perk.rpperks.smoker.name: §aSmoker
perk.rpperks.smoker.desc: Smoking improves mental state, going without makes it worse (RP).
perk.rpperks.soldier.name: §aTrained Soldier
perk.rpperks.soldier.desc: Weapons at a good soldier's level: short and long arms 5, heavy 3, explosives 2, melee 3. Basic first aid (Medicine 2).
perk.rpperks.medic.name: §aAnastasia
perk.rpperks.medic.desc: Medicine 8: complex procedures, full use of drugs, instruments and equipment.
perk.rpperks.melee_fighter.name: §aMelee Fighter
perk.rpperks.melee_fighter.desc: Melee 5: hits harder and faster with any melee weapon and bare hands, tires less in combat.
perk.rpperks.builder.name: §aRogalev
perk.rpperks.builder.desc: Basic, non-professional engineering and construction skills (RP). Mining blocks is less tiring.
perk.rpperks.gunner.name: §aFirearms Course
perk.rpperks.explosives.name: §aExplosives
perk.rpperks.explosives.desc: Explosives 5, heavy arms 1. Making, defusing and using explosive devices.
perk.rpperks.technician.name: §aDenton
perk.rpperks.technician.desc: Operates complex equipment and machinery, limited repairs (RP).
perk.rpperks.hacker.name: §aHacking
perk.rpperks.hacker.desc: Picks locks, hacks electronic systems, doors and terminals (RP).
perk.rpperks.sailor.name: §aSeafarer
perk.rpperks.sailor.desc: Knows how to fish, faster swimming, swimming is less tiring.
perk.rpperks.tailor.name: §aTailoring
perk.rpperks.farmer.name: §aFarmer
perk.rpperks.farmer.desc: Can farm, forage and identify wild plants (RP).
perk.rpperks.cook.name: §aCook
perk.rpperks.cook.desc: Cooks complex dishes and butchers carcasses (RP).
perk.rpperks.driver.name: §aDriver
perk.rpperks.pilot.name: §aPinpinych
perk.rpperks.first_aid.name: §aFirst Aid Course
perk.rpperks.first_aid.desc: Medicine 3: full first aid, basic handling of medical items.
perk.rpperks.fragile.name: §cFragile
perk.rpperks.fragile.desc: -2.5 hearts of max health, wounds heal slowly (RP).
perk.rpperks.disorganized.name: §cDisorganized
perk.rpperks.diabetic.name: §cDiabetic
perk.rpperks.anorexic.name: §cAnorexic
perk.rpperks.anorexic.desc: Small stomach: gets full quickly (without RP Culinary — at most 7 drumsticks), faster metabolism, sometimes refuses food for a while.
perk.rpperks.weakling.name: §cOut of Shape
perk.rpperks.weakling.desc: Physique 0–2. With skill growth on, disappears when Physique grows.
perk.rpperks.homebody.name: §cHomebody
perk.rpperks.homebody.desc: Poor tolerance to ambient temperature and a weak immune system (RP).
perk.rpperks.unlucky.name: §cUnlucky
perk.rpperks.unlucky.desc: If something can go wrong, it goes wrong for you. Monsters prefer you.
perk.rpperks.turtle.name: §cTurtle
perk.rpperks.wimp.name: §cWimp
perk.rpperks.wimp.desc: Strength 0–2. With skill growth on, disappears when Strength grows.
perk.rpperks.suggestible.name: §cSuggestible
perk.rpperks.suggestible.desc: More easily influenced cognitively, weaker against cognitohazards (RP).
perk.rpperks.caffeine_addiction.name: §cCaffeine Addiction
perk.rpperks.caffeine_addiction.desc: After an hour without caffeine, movement and attack speed drop by 30%. Waking up starts withdrawal.
perk.rpperks.coward.name: §cCoward
perk.rpperks.clumsy.name: §cClumsy
perk.rpperks.clumsy.desc: 5% chance to drop the item you're using.
perk.rpperks.technophobe.name: §cTechnophobe
perk.rpperks.technophobe.desc: Fears and doesn't understand complex machinery and electronics (RP).
perk.rpperks.landlubber.name: §cLandlubber
perk.rpperks.landlubber.desc: Can't swim: walks along the bottom but can't rise to the surface.
perk.rpperks.teetotaler.name: §cTeetotaler
perk.rpperks.admin.name: §dAdmin
perk.rpperks.admin.desc: Removes all restrictions and restores vanilla stats; stamina isn't spent. Other perks are suspended.
perk.rpperks.basic_training.name: §aBasic training
perk.rpperks.basic_training.desc: Short and long arms 2, melee 1, medicine 1.
perk.rpperks.pacifist.name: §cPacifist
perk.rpperks.pacifist.desc: Does not fight people: much less damage to people, combat skills capped at 1 and barely grow. Learns peaceful skills faster.
gui.rpperks.skills.growth_off: Skill growth is off on this server: levels come from perks and the GM.
gui.rpperks.skills.hint: Skills 0–10: 5 is average, 10 is master. They grow with practice; perks set a minimum.
skill.rpperks.medicine.desc: Treating people (RP Medicine). Affects: speed and precision of procedures, error chance, what an exam reveals, access to complex drugs and surgery. Grows: by treating others.
skill.rpperks.cooking.desc: Cooking (RP Culinary). Affects: dish quality, burn chance, how precisely food composition is shown. Grows: by cooking; complex dishes give more, repeats less.
skill.rpperks.short_arms.desc: Pistols and SMGs (TaCZ). Affects: spread, recoil, reload and aiming time. Grows: by shooting and hitting.
skill.rpperks.long_arms.desc: Rifles and shotguns (TaCZ). Affects: spread, recoil, reload and aiming time. Grows: by shooting and hitting.
skill.rpperks.heavy_arms.desc: Machine guns, sniper rifles, launchers (TaCZ). Affects: spread, recoil (Strength helps hold it), reload and aiming time. Grows: by shooting and hitting.
skill.rpperks.explosives.desc: Explosive weapons (TaCZ). Affects: blast power and radius of your weapons. Grows: by firing launchers.
skill.rpperks.melee.desc: Any melee weapon and bare hands. Affects: damage and attack speed. Grows: by hitting living targets.
skill.rpperks.strength.desc: Physical strength. Affects: melee damage, heavy weapon recoil, carrying the wounded. Grows: by hitting and mining; slowly drops without exercise. 0–2 — Wimp, 7+ — Strongman.
skill.rpperks.fitness.desc: Physique: physical fitness of the body. Affects: stamina pool and recovery. Grows: by running, swimming, climbing; slowly drops without exercise. 0–2 — Weakling, 7–8 — Enduring, 9–10 — Athlete.
perk.rpperks.clean.name: §aClean Freak
perk.rpperks.clean.desc: Rarely gets food poisoning from raw meat and fish (RP Culinary).
perk.rpperks.gourmet.name: §aGourmet
perk.rpperks.gourmet.desc: Monotonous food gets boring faster, but good dishes please more and stay tasty longer (RP Culinary).
perk.rpperks.fast_metabolism.name: §aFast Metabolism
perk.rpperks.fast_metabolism.desc: Burns 15% more calories: eats more often but keeps weight easily (RP Culinary).
perk.rpperks.dietitian.name: §aDietitian
perk.rpperks.dietitian.desc: Sees exact food composition and what-to-eat hints, numbers in the Nutrition window (RP Culinary).
perk.rpperks.field_cook.name: §aField Cook
perk.rpperks.field_cook.desc: Cooks on a campfire or in a smoker as if 2 Cooking levels higher (RP Culinary).
perk.rpperks.kitchen_nightmare.name: §cKitchen Nightmare
perk.rpperks.kitchen_nightmare.desc: Cooks 3 Cooking levels worse: burns food more often (RP Culinary).
perk.rpperks.slow_metabolism.name: §cProne to Weight Gain
perk.rpperks.slow_metabolism.desc: Burns 15% fewer calories: gains weight easily (RP Culinary).
gui.rpperks.skills.admin_hint: −/+ set a GM level: it does not grow by itself until cleared.
